title: Setting game speed to 1/16 in the game tab makes physics process delta 1/48 instead of 1/60
body:
### Tested versions

tested on 4.8dev3 and on 4.7 (I expect that the version is very unlikely to change the outcome)

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev3 - macOS Sequoia (15.7.4) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M3 Pro (12 threads) - 36.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When setting the game speed in the game tab while the game is running, setting any value in which 60 (the default physics ticks per second) is not divisible the denominator (for example 1/16, 60 is not evenly divisible by 16), you get a delta value in physics process which is not expected. The expected value is still 1/60 as mentioned in the docs here (https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/editor/game_embedding.html#game-speed) (the reason is so that physics remains stable across different game speeds).

When setting the game speed to 1/16, I get a delta value of 1/48 instead of 1/60. I believe this is due to a narrowing conversion when the engine implicitly sets Engine.physics_ticks_per_frame because the value is an int but 60/16 is 3.75 (which when casted to an int will be 3, and 1/3 * 1/16 is 1/48).

### Steps to reproduce

You are able to test this yourself by printing out the delta in physics process in a new project and setting the game speed to 1/4 (60/4 is a whole number so the delta will be correct as 1/60) and then setting it to 1/16 (in which case you’ll see the incorrect delta of 1/48).

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Play the game and change the game speed in the game tab. Values where 60 is evenly divisible by the denominator will have correct deltas (1/60) while others (like 1/16x game speed) will have incorrect deltas. I like to use 1/4x and 1/16x to see both a correct delta and an incorrect one respectively.

(This is literally a completely new project with a single node with just a print statement inside the physics process function to print out delta)
[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30863168/mrp.zip)
